2.152.13
ChartLegend.HeaderSeparatorColor
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartLegend.HeaderSeparatorColor element specifies the color of a chart legend header
separator. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlColor or an
expression that evaluates to an RdlColor. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as an
empty color.
Following is the parent element of the ChartLegend.HeaderSeparatorColor element.
Parent elements
ChartLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartLegend.HeaderSeparatorColor element.
 <xsd:element name="HeaderSeparatorColor" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
